a warm bronze-brown complexion, mid 30s goddess, siren bust hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other — wearing a skin-tight glossy jet-black latex catsuit with long sleeves and matching latex gloves, the front zipper pulled down to her belly button with the two sides of the latex fully covering her bust, stretched over every curve from neck to ankle with mirror shine and fine pull-creases at the elbows and knees, completely opaque, the exposed skin only a narrow V down her chest edged by the zipper teeth, and a seamless jet-black latex hood covering her whole head, face and neck with mirror shine, closed by a zipper at the back, with three openings cut in the latex: two almond-shaped openings around her eyes, a small opening for her nose and one around her lips. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, down and outward to its own huge black iron ring set in the flagstone floor on its own side. Dust clings around the openings at her eyes and her lips are dry and a little cracked, and her bare feet and toes are black with grime.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her feet to the top of her head completely visible, the chamber around her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
